messages.subject: Whitford / Kingsford Group — Harland Vesey now instructed
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

We act for Mr Daniel Whitford. We enclose (a) a draft ET1 setting out the claims our client would bring absent settlement — constructive unfair dismissal, s.103A automatically unfair dismissal, and s.47B detriment on protected-disclosure grounds — and (b) our client's schedule of loss on a full-liability basis, which totals in the region of £547,000. ACAS early conciliation is underway (certificate expected shortly).

Our client remains willing to resolve matters, but the opening offer of £150,000 does not reflect the risk your client faces on the uncapped claim. We look forward to your response.

Geoffrey Vesey
Partner, Harland Vesey LLP

messages.subject: RE: Whitford / Kingsford Group — Harland Vesey now instructed
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Vesey,

Thank you. We have your draft ET1 and schedule of loss and are taking our client's instructions. Without prejudice to our client's position on liability — which is firmly denied, particularly on causation for the s.103A/47B claims — we anticipate reverting with a revised proposal shortly. We note the schedule assumes a 15-month re-employment period and a full ACAS uplift, both of which we would resist.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Whitfield Carter LLP

--
